svg.title: dsh-safety-brief-check — one briefing record, seven gates, two ledgers
svg.desc: Left: the record parsed into BriefInput — project, briefer (empty in the sample), briefedAt, workStartAt, recipients[], signers[], trades[] and fields{}. Middle: the seven gates of rules/safety-brief-check.yaml in pack order, each reading named fields and exiting into exactly one of issues[] or skipped[]. Right: the report for the sample run — issues[] holds SB-005 and SB-006 at warn; skipped[] holds five entries (SB-001 and SB-004 never ran because requiredFields and workTrades are unset; SB-002, SB-003 and SB-007 ran and found no difference). makeReport() merges both arrays; the reviewer decides; skipped is not a pass. Footer: severity caps by evidence kind and the read-only, offline bounds.
